items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: We used to go up and down the river. We used to go out to our his hometown and play.

ctx.x: He used to play. He used to play with the Superior Baron. Bunk hit.
Did you know a clarinet player from Bay St. Louis named Sumner Labatt? Remember him? Kind of straight clarinet player.
